mapper.select: SELECT c.collection_id , c.owner_id , c.title , c.description , c.emoji , c.category , c.is_public , c.created_at , c.updated_at , u.nickname AS owner_nickname , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM places p WHERE p.collection_id = c.collection_id) AS place_count , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_members m2 WHERE m2.collection_id = c.collection_id) AS member_count , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.nickname ORDER BY t.sort_no, t.created_at, t.user_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM (SELECT u2.nickname , m3.user_id , m3.created_at , FIELD(m3.role, 'OWNER', 'EDITOR', 'VIEWER') AS sort_no FROM collection_members m3 JOIN users u2 ON u2.user_id = m3.user_id WHERE m3.collection_id = c.collection_id ORDER BY sort_no, m3.created_at, m3.user_id LIMIT 4) t) AS member_nicknames , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.profile_image ORDER BY t.sort_no, t.created_at, t.user_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM (SELECT IFNULL(u2.profile_image, '') AS profile_image , m3.user_id , m3.created_at , FIELD(m3.role, 'OWNER', 'EDITOR', 'VIEWER') AS sort_no FROM collection_members m3 JOIN users u2 ON u2.user_id = m3.user_id WHERE m3.collection_id = c.collection_id ORDER BY sort_no, m3.created_at, m3.user_id LIMIT 4) t) AS member_images FROM collections c JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.owner_id WHERE c.collection_id = #{collectionId}

SELECT c.collection_id , c.owner_id , c.title , c.description , c.emoji , c.category , c.is_public , c.created_at , u.nickname AS owner_nickname , m.role , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM places p WHERE p.collection_id = c.collection_id) AS place_count , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_members m2 WHERE m2.collection_id = c.collection_id) AS member_count , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.nickname ORDER BY t.sort_no, t.created_at, t.user_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM (SELECT u2.nickname , m3.user_id , m3.created_at , FIELD(m3.role, 'OWNER', 'EDITOR', 'VIEWER') AS sort_no FROM collection_members m3 JOIN users u2 ON u2.user_id = m3.user_id WHERE m3.collection_id = c.collection_id ORDER BY sort_no, m3.created_at, m3.user_id LIMIT 4) t) AS member_nicknames , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.profile_image ORDER BY t.sort_no, t.created_at, t.user_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM (SELECT IFNULL(u2.profile_image, '') AS profile_image , m3.user_id , m3.created_at , FIELD(m3.role, 'OWNER', 'EDITOR', 'VIEWER') AS sort_no FROM collection_members m3 JOIN users u2 ON u2.user_id = m3.user_id WHERE m3.collection_id = c.collection_id ORDER BY sort_no, m3.created_at, m3.user_id LIMIT 4) t) AS member_images , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_favorites f WHERE f.collection_id = c.collection_id AND f.user_id = #{userId}) AS is_favorite FROM collections c JOIN collection_members m ON m.collection_id = c.collection_id AND m.user_id = #{userId} JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.owner_id ORDER BY is_favorite DESC, c.updated_at DESC

SELECT c.collection_id , c.owner_id , c.title , c.description , c.emoji , c.category , c.created_at , u.nickname AS owner_nickname , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM places p WHERE p.collection_id = c.collection_id) AS place_count , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_members m2 WHERE m2.collection_id = c.collection_id) AS member_count , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.nickname ORDER BY t.sort_no, t.created_at, t.user_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM (SELECT u2.nickname , m3.user_id , m3.created_at , FIELD(m3.role, 'OWNER', 'EDITOR', 'VIEWER') AS sort_no FROM collection_members m3 JOIN users u2 ON u2.user_id = m3.user_id WHERE m3.collection_id = c.collection_id ORDER BY sort_no, m3.created_at, m3.user_id LIMIT 4) t) AS member_nicknames , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.profile_image ORDER BY t.sort_no, t.created_at, t.user_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM (SELECT IFNULL(u2.profile_image, '') AS profile_image , m3.user_id , m3.created_at , FIELD(m3.role, 'OWNER', 'EDITOR', 'VIEWER') AS sort_no FROM collection_members m3 JOIN users u2 ON u2.user_id = m3.user_id WHERE m3.collection_id = c.collection_id ORDER BY sort_no, m3.created_at, m3.user_id LIMIT 4) t) AS member_images FROM collections c JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.owner_id WHERE c.is_public = 'Y'
AND (c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
